Summary: Scope SOC 2 Type II readiness assessment
Description: Engage an auditor/advisor to gap-assess current infra, access controls, logging, and vendor management against SOC 2 Type II Trust Services Criteria. Gatsby leads every enterprise/VC-PE conversation with this cert.
Acceptance Criteria: Written gap report produced covering all 5 trust criteria; remediation backlog created from findings; target audit window agreed with leadership.

Summary: Implement staff SSO (Google Workspace + generic OIDC)
Description: Add SSO login for staff/admin accounts via Google Workspace and a generic OIDC/SAML provider, alongside existing credential login. No SSO today; Gatsby ships this as a base-plan feature.
Acceptance Criteria: Org admin can enable SSO and enforce it for their team; existing password login continues to work for orgs that don't enable it; session/permissions unchanged after login method swap.

Summary: Publish a public API + API-key auth
Description: Add a dedicated API-key auth scheme (separate from user JWT sessions) scoped per organization, plus published API docs for third-party/programmatic access. Internal Swagger exists but nothing external-facing.
Dependencies: Implement staff SSO (Google Workspace + generic OIDC)
Acceptance Criteria: External caller can mint/rotate an API key from settings; key-scoped requests are rate-limited and audit-logged; a docs page lists available endpoints and auth steps.

Summary: Add outbound webhooks for customer automation
Description: Build outbound webhook delivery (event created, RSVP changed, checked-in, etc.) with signing and retry, matching what's already marketed on the enterprise pricing tier but not implemented.
Dependencies: Publish a public API + API-key auth
Acceptance Criteria: Org can register a webhook URL and secret; selected event types deliver with signed payloads and retry-on-failure; delivery log is visible to the org.

Description: Sync RSVP status and attendance into Salesforce campaign members/activities in near-real-time, matching Gatsby's named integration.
Dependencies: Publish a public API + API-key auth
Acceptance Criteria: RSVP and check-in state changes reflect in Salesforce within a defined SLA; sync failures are visible and retryable; field mapping is configurable per org.

Description: Sync guest lists, RSVPs, attendance, and notes with Affinity, matching Gatsby's named integration for VC/PE-style relationship teams.
Acceptance Criteria: Guest and attendance data flows both directions with Affinity without duplicate contact creation; sync errors surface to the org admin.

Description: Generate a .pkpass digital pass for a guest's ticket/badge (QR + event details), downloadable from FestioHub/email, as an alternative to the current web-only pass.
Acceptance Criteria: Guest can add their pass to Apple Wallet from their ticket link; pass reflects check-in state changes (e.g. relock after entry) if feasible; Android/Google Wallet is out of scope for this ticket.

Summary: Add badge-printer integration for on-arrival printing
Description: Integrate with a common label/badge printer (e.g. via browser print API or a printer SDK) so staff can print a physical badge at check-in instead of only showing a digital ticket.
Acceptance Criteria: Staff check-in flow has a 'Print badge' action that produces a physical badge on a connected printer; failure to print does not block digital check-in.

Description: New domain model for internal event tasks (title, assignee, due date, status) scoped to an event, visible to staff/admins. Gatsby ships this as a base feature; Festio has nothing today.
Acceptance Criteria: Staff can create, assign, and complete tasks tied to an event; task list is visible on the event dashboard; completed/overdue tasks are distinguishable.

Summary: Wire calendar invites (.ics) into real invite emails
Description: Extend the existing VCALENDAR/.ics generation (currently only in the demo flow, backend/app/routers/demo.py) so real guest invitation and RSVP-confirmation emails include a working calendar attachment/'Add to calendar' link.
Acceptance Criteria: A guest receiving a real event invite or RSVP confirmation gets a working .ics attachment that opens correctly in Google/Outlook/Apple Calendar; multi-day events produce a correct multi-day or per-session calendar entry.

Description: Extend existing capacity/rsvp_capacity fields with an actual waitlist queue: guests who RSVP after capacity is hit are queued, and promoted automatically (or by staff action) as spots free up, with notification on promotion.
Acceptance Criteria: RSVPs beyond capacity are queued instead of rejected; a freed spot promotes the next queued guest and notifies them; staff can see and manually reorder/promote the queue.

Description: New grouping concept for guests belonging to the same family/household, distinct from seating TableGroup, so invites/RSVPs/communications can be managed at the household level the way Gatsby's 'Families' object does.
Acceptance Criteria: Staff can group guests into a household; household-level actions (e.g. one invite, one RSVP covering the household) work correctly; existing seating TableGroup behavior is unaffected.
